name: Grimsby
doing: writing in his diary on a bench by the station
thought: The pigeons passed me by without a glance. Not surprising, given the way I keep my list.

feeling.words: The sun is a slow drip of orange, melting into the tiles. The teaspoon glints like a secret. I have not made a mistake today.

place.name: a bench by the station
place.words: on a bench by the station
